name: Resting
overview: Scripture reveals that true rest originates from God, who ceased His creative work on the seventh day, establishing a pattern of rest (Genesis 2:2). Believers are called to trust fully in the Lord rather than their own understanding (Proverbs 3:5), and Jesus invites those burdened to come to Him for rest that refreshes the soul (Matthew 11:28). Furthermore, the book of Hebrews assures that a lasting rest remains for God's people, symbolized by the keeping of a sabbath (Hebrews 4:9), pointing to the spiritual rest found in Christ.
